result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a car-centric design with wide asphalt expanses and large curb radii at commercial entrances. While sidewalks and a faded crosswalk are present, the lack of protected crossings and high-speed turning potential at the gas station create significant safety risks.

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radii
hazards.description: The large radius at the gas station entrance allows vehicles to turn at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians on the sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side at the gas station entrance

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks across the main thoroughfare, forcing pedestrians to cross unprotected.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground across the main road

hazards.name: Faded Pavement Markings
hazards.description: Existing crosswalk and lane markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection on the right

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings across all legs of the intersection to improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles at the intersection and gas station entrance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and curb ramps, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure. However, the crossing distance is substantial across multiple lanes of traffic without a pedestrian refuge island or clearly visible pedestrian-specific signals.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk spanning the wide roadway

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian refuge
hazards.description: There is no median or island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians who cannot complete the crossing in one cycle.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection along the crosswalk path

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to shorten the unprotected crossing distance and provide a safe haven.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to further reduce crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Ensure pedestrian-specific signal heads with countdown timers are installed and visible for all crossing directions.

result.summary: The intersection features marked crosswalks and curb ramps with tactile paving, but pedestrian movement is hindered by a utility pole positioned in the center of the corner sidewalk. Additionally, a vehicle is parked across a portion of the pedestrian path, and the wide corner radius may facilitate higher vehicle turning speeds.

hazards.name: Utility pole obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility pole is located directly in the middle of the corner sidewalk, obstructing the path for pedestrians, especially those with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left on the corner sidewalk

hazards.name: Sidewalk parking
hazards.description: A black car is parked across what appears to be a pedestrian walkway or the edge of a vacant lot, forcing pedestrians to detour.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, behind the corner

hazards.name: Wide curb radius
hazards.description: The corner has a wide radius which can encourage vehicles to make turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground corner

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to tighten the turning radius and reduce the crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Move the utility pole to the edge of the sidewalk to provide a clear, unobstructed path for all users.

interventions.title: Bollards or Perimeter Fencing
interventions.description: Install physical barriers to prevent vehicles from parking on or encroaching upon the pedestrian walkway.

result.summary: The environment is a residential intersection lacking basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or traffic control signals. While sidewalks are present, the wide, unmarked roadway and parked vehicles near the corner create visibility and safety challenges for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the intersection

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the intersection corner may block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.
